title: Virtual CFO Engagement — E-commerce Sector
metaTitle: Virtual CFO Engagement Overview | NRSR & Co
metaDesc: An overview of a Virtual CFO advisory engagement for an entity in the e-commerce sector.
summary: A Virtual CFO engagement covering periodic financial reporting and cash flow monitoring was carried out for an e-commerce-sector entity.
challenge: The entity did not have a dedicated in-house finance leadership function and required periodic financial reporting and cash flow visibility to support its operations.
solution: The engagement was structured as a retainer-based Virtual CFO arrangement, covering monthly financial reporting, cash flow monitoring, and periodic budget review sessions.
execution: Monthly reporting cycles were established with the entity's internal accounts team, along with a recurring review meeting to go through financial statements and cash flow forecasts.
